prompt: Create a photorealistic photograph of a single honeybee resting on a weathered wooden hive frame, its translucent wings catching soft morning light. shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field, overcast golden hour. visible pollen grains dusting its fuzzy thorax, delicate wax cells blurred in background, dew droplets on wood grain featuring in a photorealistic photography style, under silver moonlight, romantic tender atmosphere, slow push-in. perfect motion blur only on moving elements consistent identity across frames movie-level temporal coherence fluid cloth simulation sharp focus rich background detail.
promptEn: Create a photorealistic photograph of a single honeybee resting on a weathered wooden hive frame, its translucent wings catching soft morning light. shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field, overcast golden hour. visible pollen grains dusting its fuzzy thorax, delicate wax cells blurred in background, dew droplets on wood grain featuring in a photorealistic photography style, under silver moonlight, romantic tender atmosphere, slow push-in. perfect motion blur only on moving elements consistent identity across frames movie-level temporal coherence fluid cloth simulation sharp focus rich background detail.
promptZh: 创作一张照片级逼真的摄影作品，主体为一只 单只蜜蜂 停在 风化的木制蜂巢框 上，其半透明的翅膀捕捉着 柔和的晨光。使用 85mm f/1.4 镜头拍摄，浅景深，阴天黄金时刻。毛茸茸的胸部上覆盖着清晰可见的花粉粒，背景中精致的蜂蜡巢房呈现模糊效果，木纹上的露珠在照片级逼真的摄影风格中格外突出，在银色月光下，营造出浪漫温柔的氛围，缓慢推近镜头。仅在运动元素上呈现完美的动态模糊，跨帧保持一致的身份特征，电影级的时序连贯性，流畅的布料模拟，清晰的对焦，丰富的背景细节。
